scope.goal: Carry the accepted Blender/gameplay foliage interpretation into the engine without replacing the recovered material-local shader or placement evidence.

unchanged: source texture roles and authored mip chains
preserved_evidence_boundary.policy: Reviewed modes are selected only for the known Route 1 material names. Exact local modes remain named, implemented, and testable.

materials.additional_treatment: Color-blend GreenColor into the local composite with 1 - luminance(Texture02).

materials.note: The engine retains the source BuildModel grass02 mesh and textures rather than substituting Blender's tree006 duplicate. Its final -0.05 hue, 0.72 saturation, and 0.95 value are therefore a source-model-specific translation, not the Blender tree006 node values.

display_context.engine_translation: A foliage-local filmic shoulder and luminance-dependent highlight desaturation translate the accepted material calibration into the engine's direct-sRGB LGPE output.

canonical_uv_finding.finding: The reviewed presentation must sample canonical source UV0 directly because canonical texture rows are uploaded in top-down order. Re-applying the source program's vertical convention selects the opposite atlas rows.
canonical_uv_finding.blender_cross_check: For tree004, an original loop V of 1.1132961511611938 maps to accepted LGPE_SourceUV0 V -0.11329615116119385, proving the Blender presentation layer already performed the 1 - V conversion.
canonical_uv_finding.implementation: Reviewed modes use raw engine UV0 and reverse only the generated vertical normal-lookup coordinate. Exact local modes retain their decoded source-program UV behavior.

ground_shrub_highlight_refinement.finding: The source BuildModel material authors GreenColor as [0, 0, 0], so it cannot preserve a green hue when the shared foliage display shoulder acts on the bright lower leaf cards.
ground_shrub_highlight_refinement.implementation: Mode 26 alone restores the measured linear mint palette progressively across its high-luminance leaves. Dark and midtone leaves, all tree modes, source geometry, alpha, textures, and placement remain unchanged.

tests: Vulkan direct, Vulkan indirect, and both dual-source world fragment variants compile.
OpenGL, Vulkan, and D3D12 runtime backend contracts boot and report the shared signature 2d637fef00f62903.
PAC_LgpeQualification retains all Route 1 tree/shrub group and triangle counts under reviewed modes 21 through 26.

not_claimed: The reviewed presentation modes are not decoded Game Freak shader programs.
The foliage-local filmic display translation is not the game's native final post-processing.
The BuildModel lower-shrub color translation is not a substitution of Blender's tree006 geometry or textures.
Native ten-tap projected depth-shadow PCF remains outside this pass.
